summary: Evaxion A/S filed a Form 6-K on May 4, 2026, to announce a press release regarding a business update and first quarter 2026 financial results scheduled for May 7, 2026. No traditional special-situation transaction (e.g., acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring) is described. The filing is a routine notification of an earnings event and conference call, not a transformative corporate action.
